page.overview:
Who is Flame Prince?

DJ Flame, whose true name is Phelix Principio, and was formerly Flame Prince, is the gender-swapped version of Flame Princess. He was created by Natasha Allegri in her artwork. He makes his debut in the show as a cameo in the episode "The Prince Who Wanted Everything." In Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake, it is confirmed that he is real in another dimension and is Fionna's human DJ ex-boyfriend, DJ Flame.

He has fire-like hair styled up and a big red jewel on his forehead. He also has yellow skin and pointed ears. He wears an orange and red suit and matching boots, each with a red jewel on it. However, in "The Prince Who Wanted Everything", his boots were brown instead of orange.

In the episode Five Short Tables, Fionna saw Flame Prince in the library and awkwardly tried to hide from him, implying that they must have had a relationship in the past that ended in a bad breakup, the same way Finn and Flame Princess did. So, basically their relationship is the same as that of their genderswaps.

In "Fionna Campbell", it is seen that the two were dating and were seemingly happy but he broke up with her by text, which hurt her a lot. In The Bear and the Rose, Fionna decided that both should remain friends, realizing that they are not right for each other to be together but, they still show care and support for each other.
